rows.title: JCET board approves private A-share placement to specific investors
rows.detail: Board (9th board, 5th extraordinary meeting) approved issuing A shares to no more than 35 specific investors including the controlling shareholder; not more than 12,787.7237 ten-thousand shares; proceeds for HPC high-end advanced packaging platform expansion, high-end power-module packaging capacity upgrade, wafer-level packaging platform upgrade, high-density memory SiP capability upgrade, working capital and bank-loan repayment. State-owned-asset approval obtained in principle; still needs shareholder approval, SSE review and CSRC registration (status per the 2026 Q3 report). Amount as stated: not more than RMB 65 hundred million.
